items.title: Perception Meets Precision: Parent-Reported Outcomes of Intermediate Rhinoplasty in Unilateral Cleft Lip
items.fact_zh: 印尼唇腭裂中心 2019–2025 年的中期鼻整形患儿，28 位家长中 20 位完成 Byrne 问卷，随访 1.5 个月至 6 年。90% 满意；鼻尖突度中位分 5 升到 8.5，对称性 5 到 7，通气 8 到 9。
items.take_zh: 创新点：用经验证的问卷把家长眼中的效果量成可比的分数，随访跨度近 6 年。意义：术前谈话可以把突度、对称性大概能改善多少讲成具体档次，不只说会好看一些；但无对照、年龄跨度大，只能当参考。
items.scene_zh: 家长问孩子唇裂的鼻子现在做还是等长大做，我说中期先做一回，多数家长事后觉得鼻尖立起来了，但一次做不完美，长大还要再看。
items.fact_en: Parents of children with unilateral cleft lip and palate who had intermediate rhinoplasty at Indonesia's national cleft centre between 2019 and 2025 were surveyed with the validated Byrne Questionnaire; 20 of 28 eligible parents responded (71.4%), with follow-up from 1.5 months to almost 6 years. Ninety percent reported satisfaction, and median scores rose from 5 to 8.5 for tip projection, 5 to 7 for symmetry, 5 to 7 for appearance and 8 to 9 for breathing.
items.take_en: The innovation is quantifying the parent's view with a validated instrument across a follow-up span of nearly six years, albeit in a small single-centre sample. It lets a consultation put expected gains in projection and symmetry into concrete grades instead of vague reassurance, but the absence of a control group and the wide age range keep it at the level of reference data.
